SELECT per.id, per.org_id orgId, per.prepaid_id memberCard, pbio.name consumerName, (select name from patient_base_info where id = ppi.patient_id ) as masterCardName, per.expend_principal expendPrincipal, per.expend_gift expendGift, per.remarks remarks, per.crt_id operatorId, per.crt_name operatorName, date_format(per.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') operatingTime, per.upt_id uptId, per.upd_name updName, per.upd_time updTime, pbio.name expendName FROM prepaid_expend_record per LEFT JOIN patient_base_info pbio ON per.patient_id = pbio.id LEFT JOIN patient_prepayments_info ppi ON ppi.prepayment_number = per.prepaid_id WHERE 1 = 1
and per.prepaid_id = #{form.prepaidId}
and per.prepaid_id is null
and per.inservice = 1 and per.type = 0
UNION
SELECT per.id, per.org_id orgId, per.prepaid_id memberCard, pbio.name consumerName, (select name from patient_base_info where id = ppi.patient_id ) as masterCardName, per.expend_principal expendPrincipal, per.expend_gift expendGift, per.remarks remarks, per.crt_id operatorId, per.crt_name operatorName, date_format(per.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') operatingTime, per.upt_id uptId, per.upd_name updName, per.upd_time updTime, pbio.name expendName FROM prepaid_expend_record per LEFT JOIN patient_base_info pbio ON per.patient_id = pbio.id LEFT JOIN patient_prepayments_info ppi ON ppi.prepayment_number = per.prepaid_id WHERE 1 = 1
and per.patient_id = #{form.patientId}
and per.patient_id is null
and per.inservice = 1 and per.type = 0

SELECT ppr.master_card_id masterCardId, ppi.prepayment_number prepaymentNumber, pbi.name
FROM patient_prepayment_relation ppr JOIN patient_prepayments_info ppi ON ppi.patient_id = ppr.master_card_id JOIN patient_base_info pbi ON pbi.id = ppr.master_card_id WHERE ppr.secondary_card_id = #{patientId}
